description: This file contains performance test functions for embedded firmware, including timing and math benchmarks, as well as setup functions for runtime diagnostics and testing in a firmware project.

classes.name: Engine
classes.description: Represents the engine state and configuration used for performance testing.

methods.name: testSystemCalls
methods.description: Measures the execution time of system calls like getTime and pin control.

methods.name: testRusefiMethods
methods.description: Performs CPU-bound function calls related to engine configuration and sensor updates for performance measurement.

methods.name: testMath
methods.description: Runs various mathematical computations (integer, float, double) to benchmark CPU performance.

methods.name: runTests
methods.description: Initiates a series of performance tests with a specified iteration count.

methods.name: timeInfo
methods.description: Logs current system time information and status related to real-time clock and hal time.

methods.name: runChibioTest
methods.description: Prints firmware configuration flags for debugging and checks.
